entries.title: A wholly unreadable Suggestion Preferences record survives Delete Circle history with retained Insight attribution, and Export omits it
details: A preferences record THIRTY can't read as a whole (newer schema, malformed list field, not JSON) is left exactly as stored by Delete, which reports success; any Insight attribution inside it remains durable.
Export does not include the unreadable record (Export passes the in-memory preferences, which read as empty).
Such a record is not applied to recommendations, Plan stage 5 or Insights.
Deleting or rewriting it automatically could destroy explicit user-owned preferences or newer-schema fields (R8.1 RL-3).
entries.releaseCondition: No commercial release until a safe Delete/Export disposition is implemented and verified.

entries.title: Insight I1/I2 retry repeats the action after a manual reversal
entries.rootCause: InsightsNotifier.apply consulted the Insight's own provenance only in the stale branch; a manual Pause, Leave or stopGentler can make the claim current again, so the retry acted again (and dated the mark with the retry day).
entries.fix: insights_provider.dart apply(): provenance first for current and stale snapshots (_appliedOn), mark from the provenance date, never act; then current/stale (architecture contract 2; founder decision D3).
tests: r83_insight_attribution_test.dart: R82-N01 I1 Pause, I1 Leave, I2 stopGentler, D3 original date
auditor_controls: Astra Appendix B R82-N01 x3

entries.title: A queued manual I3 exclusion is recorded as the Insight's application
entries.rootCause: apply() did not wait for the preference queue, and SuggestionPreferencesNotifier._save returned true for a no-op, which _leaveOut mapped to done.
entries.fix: suggestion_preferences.dart: PreferenceChange outcome (changed / unchanged / refused / notSaved), leaveOutChange(), idle(); insights_provider.dart: apply waits for the preferences, maps unchanged to alreadyApplied (no mark). Public Future<bool> API kept.

entries.title: startedAfterExpiry cannot be cleared on disk; credit wrongly withheld after a restart
entries.rootCause: ServedStageCircle.toJson spread the stored source map and wrote startedAfterExpiry only when true, so a cleared flag kept the stored true; _durable held the model, hiding the divergence until restart.
entries.fix: circle_plan.dart ServedStageCircle.toJson: source minus every known key, then the known fields from the model (absence for false/null). Stage still written back as stored (A05).
tests: r83_start_boundary_test.dart AUD-N1 end to end + 2 controls
auditor_controls: Claude AUD-N1 domain and end-to-end; Astra Appendix B R82-N03

entries.title: Valid AppliedInsight extension fields are discarded
entries.rootCause: AppliedInsight kept only its three known fields for a valid record.
entries.fix: circle_plan.dart AppliedInsight.extra: unknown fields of a stored valid record written back; a new application is a new record without them.

entries.title: A pending Start crossing local midnight starts yesterday's offer
entries.rootCause: The day was checked at the tap only; the post-save continuation of _startOnceSaved checked identity and status, not the day.
entries.fix: recommendation_provider.dart _startOnceSaved: the day is checked again immediately before the started transition; if it has passed, nothing starts and nowProvider is invalidated (the existing tap-after-midnight behaviour, no new copy).

entries.title: A deleted session's Start / Close-request instant is written back after Delete
entries.rootCause: CirclePlansNotifier._startedAt/_closeRequestedAt were not cleared by forgetStageEvidence; Circle ids are day keys, so a same-day re-serve matched.
entries.fix: circle_plans_provider.dart forgetStageEvidence clears both maps in Delete's synchronous phase.
tests: r83_delete_boundary_test.dart AUD-N2 Pause and Leave variants + control

entries.title: Delete persists a Plan change that was reported as not saved
entries.rootCause: Delete computed its Plans write from the optimistic state at the moment Delete began and dropped _queued, so a later-refused pending change was written by the Delete and its rollback skipped.
entries.fix: circle_plans_provider.dart forgetStageEvidence (founder decision D4): memory still cleared at once; the write is computed at its own queue turn from the last confirmed Plans (_durable) without evidence; on success or failure what is shown returns to that confirmed state unless the user changed it since.
tests: r83_delete_boundary_test.dart AUD-N3 + held-success control + refused-intent control

entries.title: A stage Circle whose Plan was paused before its valid Start is credited later, once the Plan is active again
entries.evidence: repro_before_fix/r83_probe_d2_later_credit_test.dart.txt: P1 (pending Start, Pause, Close, Resume, restart) 1 credit; P2 (no pending: Pause, Start, Close, Resume, restart) 1 credit; P3 (Resume then Pause again, no restart) 1 credit; identical on R8.2 and after R8.3.
entries.cause: recordGuided judges eligibility by the Plan's lifecycle at the moment it runs; the restart catch-up (_mirrorInJournal) and the decision-A fold (_withEarnedCredits) re-run it after a Resume, when the Plan is active, with nothing recording that the Close happened while it was paused.
entries.severity: LOW-MEDIUM: a Plan stage credited that the founder's rule says earns none; no Premium access, no data loss.
entries.status: OPEN - founder decision required (stop condition: historical credit semantics). Not fixed: a fix needs a new persisted fact on the served record and a policy answer for P4 (Pause, Start, Resume, Close - currently credited).

r831.founderDecision: 2026-11-07: Option B - the eligibility of the Circle's original valid Start determines historical Plan credit; a later lifecycle change never makes an ineligible Start eligible.
r831.rootCauseConfirmed: recordGuided judged eligibility by the Plan's lifecycle when it ran. It is re-run after a Resume by (1) the restart catch-up (_mirrorInJournal), (2) the decision-A fold (_withEarnedCredits) on the next lifecycle change, and (3) the next day's overwrite safety net (_recordBeforeOverwrite), which runs after the new day's serve has replaced lastServed. Nothing durable recorded that the valid Start was made while paused.
r831.fix: PlanProgress.startedWhilePaused (optional circleId; damaged value makes the Plan unreadable; unknown fields kept). Written - and confirmed - at the valid Start when the Plan is paused as shown (Today _startOnceSaved; the fast path is refused when it is needed, so the Start waits, decision B; refused, the Start is refused). recordGuided never credits that Circle. Removed by Delete with the other stage evidence.
